book.title: PHP: The Right Way
book.page_convention: PDF page (markers === PAGE N ===); the PDF has no printed numbering

topics.title: Stable PHP version (8.5) and end of life of 7.4
topics.summary: Start with the current stable version (8.5 at capture time); 7.4 is already EOL; few breaking changes between 8.0 and 8.5. The book does not give the support cycle or the EOL of 8.0-8.3.

topics.title: Built-in web server (php -S)
topics.summary: php -S localhost:8000 from the web root, with PHP 5.4+, for learning/developing locally. The -t option and the warning not to use it in production are not in the book.

topics.title: Installation: macOS, Windows, Linux
topics.summary: Homebrew, MacPorts, phpbrew, Liip; Windows binaries (VM/WSL if publishing to Linux); Ondrej Sury's PPA (Ubuntu), bikeshed (Debian), Remi (RPM).

topics.title: Common directory structure
topics.summary: DocumentRoot in public/, tests/ for tests, vendor/ for Composer (Standard PHP Package Skeleton); configuration outside the public directory.

topics.title: Style guide and PSRs (named only)
topics.summary: PSR-1, PSR-12, PSR-4 and PER cited without detailing the rules; PHP_CodeSniffer, phpcbf, php-cs-fixer with commands; pre-commit hook; symbol names in English.

topics.title: Paradigms: OOP, functional, metaprogramming
topics.summary: History 5.0/5.3/5.4; OOP; first-class functions and closures since 5.3; Reflection and magic methods (__call/__callStatic).

topics.title: Namespaces, PSR-0 and PSR-4
topics.summary: Namespaces avoid name collisions; PSR-4 recommended for new code; PSR-0 deprecated in October 2014.

topics.title: Standard PHP Library (SPL)
topics.summary: Data structures (stack, queue, heap) and iterators; SplFixedArray is not mentioned.

topics.title: Command line (CLI)
topics.summary: CLI scripts; php -i and -a; $argc/$argv; exit with a non-zero code; do not put CLI scripts in the web root.

topics.title: Xdebug
topics.summary: Debugger with breakpoints and stack inspection, basis for coverage and profiling; the book's configuration is for Xdebug 2 (DATED).

topics.title: Composer and Packagist
topics.summary: Installation, require/init/install, vendor/autoload.php, shared composer.lock, do not use update on deploy, ~ and * constraints, security checker.

topics.title: PEAR
topics.summary: Veteran manager that installs globally and requires prepared packages; Composer 2 does not support PEAR repositories directly (manual workaround).

topics.title: Date and time: DateTime, DateInterval, DatePeriod
topics.summary: DateTime, createFromFormat, format, add/sub/diff with DateInterval, DatePeriod, Carbon; do not assume days have the same number of seconds. DateTimeImmutable is not mentioned.

topics.title: Design patterns (links only)
topics.summary: General text on using patterns; it only points to refactoring.guru and designpatternsphp. Singleton/Factory/Strategy are not described.

topics.title: UTF-8: mbstring, utf8mb4, headers
topics.summary: PHP has no low-level Unicode support; use mb_*; mb_internal_encoding/mb_http_output; utf8mb4 in the database and the DSN; Content-Type charset=UTF-8.

topics.title: Internationalization and localization with gettext
topics.summary: i18n/l10n/pluralization concepts, gettext, PO/MO/POT files, locales, plural forms, gettext/ngettext functions, Poedit 1.8 (DATED).

topics.title: Dependency injection
topics.summary: DI by constructor, method or property; Database/MySqlAdapter example; IoC and DIP.

topics.title: SOLID principles
topics.summary: SRP, OCP, LSP, ISP and DIP with the book's examples (FileInterface, steeringWheel/handlebars, AdapterInterface).

topics.title: DI containers and Service Locator
topics.summary: A container is not DI; it can become a Service Locator (anti-pattern); modern frameworks ship a container.

topics.title: mysql extension removed; mysqli and PDO
topics.summary: ext/mysql removed in PHP 7.0; migrate to mysqli or PDO; do not do a find-and-replace mysql_*->mysqli_*.

topics.title: PDO and bound parameters
topics.summary: PDO abstracts the connection (it does not translate SQL); statements with bound parameters prevent SQL Injection; filter input first; PDO sanitizes only for SQL.

topics.title: Separating data access from presentation
topics.summary: Do not mix queries with HTML; separate into function/files, Model and View; makes testing easier.

topics.title: Database abstraction layers
topics.summary: Layers that emulate features across databases; library list; Data Mapper/Active Record are not covered.

topics.title: Templates: plain PHP and compiled
topics.summary: Benefits of templates; plain PHP (Plates, Aura.View) versus compiled (Twig, Smarty...); automatic escaping depends on the library; Smarty does not enable it by default.

topics.title: Errors, severity and error_reporting()
topics.summary: PHP is exception-light; E_ERROR/E_WARNING/E_NOTICE/E_STRICT; error_reporting() at runtime.

topics.title: The @ operator and xdebug.scream
topics.summary: @ swallows the error, costs performance and cannot be turned off in production; use ?? when possible; xdebug.scream only for debugging.

topics.title: ErrorException
topics.summary: ErrorException extends Exception and converts errors into exceptions (Symfony/Laravel practice); set_error_handler does not appear.

topics.title: Exceptions and SPL Exceptions
topics.summary: Throw exceptions instead of exit/false; try/catch/finally; subclasses and SPL exceptions (e.g. BadMethodCallException). The Throwable hierarchy is not covered.

topics.title: Web application security
topics.summary: Four big themes (code-data separation, logic, environment, cryptography); OWASP as required reading.

topics.title: Password hashing
topics.summary: Hash vs encryption; individual salt; specialized algorithm instead of a fast general-purpose hash (cites SHA256; md5/sha1 are not named); June 2018 list (DATED); password_hash since 5.5; password_verify; no salt column.

topics.title: Data filtering, sanitization and validation
topics.summary: Never trust foreign input; filter_var/filter_input; XSS and output escaping; escapeshellarg; file paths; unserialize is dangerous (prefer JSON); validation.

topics.title: Configuration files
topics.summary: Keep them out of direct reach; if in the document root, use a .php extension; protect them; do not version sensitive data.

topics.title: register_globals (removed)
topics.summary: Removed in 5.4.0; it let $_GET['foo'] become $foo and overwrite variables.

topics.title: Error reporting in development and production
topics.summary: Dev: display_errors On, error_reporting -1; production: display_errors Off, display_startup_errors Off, error_reporting E_ALL, log_errors On.

topics.title: Automated testing and TDD
topics.summary: Automated tests as a good practice; TDD; unit test by behavior; PHPUnit as the de facto tool; alternatives atoum, Kahlan, Peridot, Pest, SimpleTest.

topics.title: Integration and functional tests
topics.summary: Integration tests exercise combined modules; functional tests use the real application; tools Codeception, Cypress, Mink, Selenium, Storyplayer.

topics.title: BDD and complementary tools
topics.summary: SpecBDD (PHPSpec) and StoryBDD (Behat/Gherkin); Mockery, Prophecy, php-mock, Infection, PHPUnit Polyfills.

topics.title: PaaS, nginx, Apache, PHP-FPM, shared hosting
topics.summary: nginx + PHP-FPM; Apache with mod_php requires prefork; worker/event with FastCGI; mod_proxy_fcgi in Apache 2.4; shared hosting and the PHP version.

topics.title: Build, deploy, provisioning and CI
topics.summary: Automate build/deploy tasks; Phing, Capistrano, Ansistrano, Deployer, Magallanes; Ansible/Puppet/Chef; CI with Travis (DATED) and GitHub Actions.

topics.title: Virtualization: Vagrant and Docker
topics.summary: Vagrant for reproducible VMs; Docker as a lightweight alternative; the book's docker run php:apache command; beware of unofficial images.

topics.title: Opcode cache (OPcache)
topics.summary: An opcode cache avoids recompiling; Zend OPcache built in since 5.5, normally enabled; check opcache.enable and phpinfo(); gain numbers and opcache.* parameters are not in the book.

topics.title: Object cache: APCu and memcached
topics.summary: APCu (tied to the server, shared between processes in FPM) versus memcached (network service); apcu_fetch/apcu_add example.

topics.title: PHPDoc
topics.summary: Informal comment standard; tags @author, @link, @param, @return, @throws; explicit @return void.

topics.title: Frameworks and components
topics.summary: Three kinds of framework (micro, full-stack, components); component repositories (Packagist, PEAR); component list.

topics.title: Books, videos and community
topics.summary: Free and paid books, video channels, user groups, conferences; warns to avoid books about 'PHP 6'.

not_in_book.note: declare(strict_types=1) is not covered by the PRW.
The PHP 7/8 type system is not taught (only interface type-hints in DI, p.39-41).
Arrow functions and the use clause of closures are not in the book.
PHP 8.x features are not in the book; the PHP-8.x-Release-Notes PDFs in the collection are only the site menu.
The Throwable/Error hierarchy is not covered; only Exception, ErrorException and SPL Exceptions.
set_error_handler does not appear; only ErrorException (p.54).
DateTimeImmutable/DateTimeZone are not in the book; it uses DateTime (p.20-21).
GoF patterns are not described (links only, p.22).
PSR-11 and PSRs other than 1, 4, 12, PER (and PSR-0) do not appear.
CSRF, hash_equals/random_bytes and Argon2id are not in the book (it mentions Argon2 in general, p.57).
The PHPUnit API and static analysis are not in the book.
FPM/OPcache tuning and asynchronous runtimes are not in the book.
ORMs and persistence patterns are not covered (only the list of abstraction layers, p.46-47).
Outside the scope of the book.
